hero.line1: You don't need a business degree
hero.description: Vaizen is an IP licensing marketplace. Our core principle for creative innovation lies in absolute simplicity — structure the workflows, and you'll be open to more exciting opportunities.

problem.title: How a $230B Market Still Runs on Email
problem.subtitle: The infrastructure gap Vaizen was built to close

challenges.title: Discovery Is Broken
challenges.description: Gauge the audience requirement even before you send an email. Rights holders have no persistent, searchable layer to reach buyers efficiently.

challenges.title: Licensing Lives in Email Chains
challenges.description: A proper analysis layer dashboard helps you gauge the potential of a territory for your rights. No more back-and-forth chains to find out if a window is available.

challenges.title: Markets Are Gatekeepers
challenges.description: Whether you want to start small, or you wish to go big — we're right there with you. Grow as you please, without needing a hotel room in the South of France.

variables.title: Supply and Demand, Finally Connected
variables.subtitle: Vaizen closes the gap that has existed since film markets moved online

items.title: The Rights Holders
items.description: 40,000+ films are produced globally every year. The majority are independent productions with no distribution infrastructure. They have titles, avails, and materials — they just can't reach buyers efficiently. Vaizen solves that.

items.title: The Buyers
items.description: Streaming platforms, broadcasters, and distributors have tripled their acquisition budgets in five years. They need a reliable, searchable source of indie content with declared avails. Vaizen is that source.
